sloka: नैव रात्रं न दिवसं न मुहूर्तं न च क्षणम् ।रामरावणयोर्युद्धं विराममुपगच्छति ।। ६.११०.३८ ।।
transliteration: naiva rātraṁ na divasaṁ na muhūrtaṁ na ca kṣaṇam ।rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṁ virāmamupagacchati ।। 6.110.38 ।।

translations.english: The Devas, Danavas, Yakshasas also the fiends Demon, Nagas and Rakshasas watched the great war that continued for seven days and nights.
